_doc: Thresholds and mesh roles for the rig integrity guards (M1-CHR-14): tools/dev/rig_probe.py and tools/tests/test_rig_integrity.py. 'defaults' apply to every hero; 'heroes' override them key by key (dicts merge, lists and values replace). Mesh specs are glTF mesh names, optionally 'Mesh:material' for one primitive. Lengths are in millimetres. See docs/kb/art/characters/pipeline.md, 'Rig integrity guards'.

defaults._every_nth_frame: the clip key stride the tests sample (15 fps keys; 3 = every 0.2 s, and always the last key)
defaults._max_samples_per_clip: long clips (the 6 s idle) widen the stride to give about this many samples; --every N on the CLI samples every clip at N instead
defaults._stage_poses: label -> stage scene whose world_pose (AshaStage._apply_world_pose) is checked too

penetration._max_mm: deepest allowed garment-in-skin, prop-in-skin or skin-through-garment penetration
penetration._max_depth_mm: deeper than this the nearest skin is taken to be the far side of a limb or a hidden-face hole, not a penetration
penetration._confirm_deepest: per group and pose, this many deepest garment/prop candidates are confirmed inside the skin by its winding number (the count reported is of confirmed vertices among them)
penetration._facing_min: |cos| between (point - closest skin point) and the skin normal there; below it the closest point is past an open boundary of the skin and inside/outside is undefined
penetration._neighbours: closest points are exact over the triangles around this many nearest skin vertices
penetration._reach_margin_mm: skin vertices are searched within max_depth_mm plus this; anything farther is clear of the skin
penetration._cover_mm: a body vertex is covered when a ray along its normal meets a garment within this at rest; that cloth point (triangle + barycentrics) is tracked, and skin that passes it in a pose pokes through (rest-relative)
penetration._grip_bones: props may touch skin owned by these bones (the hand that holds them)
penetration._limits_count: per-group cap on how many vertices pass max_mm in any one pose; used with a per-hero limits_mm allowance

seams._weld_tol_mm: positions closer than this at rest count as one welded position
seams._max_open_mm: how far positions welded at rest (the neck seam, UV seams, panel seams) may separate in a pose
seams._cover_reach_mm: an open body-boundary vertex is covered when a ray along its normal meets a garment within this (rays pass through skin, so the inner side of a leg under a skirt counts as covered)

defaults._allowances: Per-hero limits_mm / limits_count / max_exposed are RATCHETS (M1-CHR-14): each pins a known linear-blend-skinning limit, viewed in the clip shots, at about today's worst. Lower them when a fix lands; never raise one without a reason in the hero's '_allowances' note.
defaults._prop_grip: M2-CHR-515 (M1-QA-09): a hero in game/data/characters/grips.json keeps its prop in the fist in every pose: the fist's grip point stays on the shaft's axis (max_offset_mm; sliding along the shaft is free) and the prop turns in the hand's frame by no more than hero_clips.prop_pivot's cap (max_turn_deg: it pivots in the fist to clear the skirt and legs), and no line along the shaft (its centre and four lines at surface_lines_at x its median radius) crosses a garment outside grip_clear_mm of the fist
defaults._hidden_props: mesh -> "battle" (or a list of clips): a prop the scene hides in those clips is not checked there

braid._min_strand_verts: connected pieces of the braid mesh at least this big are the woven strands (the rest are flyaways and tail cards)
braid._root_ring_mm: a strand's root ring: its open-end vertices within this of the end vertex nearest the scalp at rest
braid._max_gap_mm: the root ring must touch the hair cap or scalp (closest ring vertex, signed: inside counts as 0)
braid._max_drift_mm: how far a root vertex may move in the head bone's frame (0 when skinned to the head)

asha._allowances: M1-CHR-15 (every-frame worst in brackets). Costume 34/6 (32.8): the sandal soles sit inside the feet at rest; the skirts are clean in every frame (skirt panels: 43.8 -> 32.8; the old worst was the skirt in the calf-thigh fold of the deep kneel). VerseSleeve 36/6 (35.5, walk): the sleeve's inner elbow against the waist as the arm hangs (her staff arm now hangs 6 degrees wider, and the hanging bag rides the shoulder corrective). Body 47/24 (46.7): the extreme_pose stage pose, the right arm raised 80 degrees forward (the front of the shoulder passes the vest's armhole edge, as in M1-CHR-14); in the clips the armpit is 37.7 at worst (attack), down from 46 in walk and laugh before the shoulder correctives. max_exposed 2: two halter-edge vertices at the right shoulder, under 2 mm. ADR 0140 (16 skirt panels, the even ones derived): Body count 24 -> 25: float_boat's crouch counts one more Body vertex through the Costume than before (25, at 41 mm, under the 47 mm limit; the worst is still extreme_pose's armpit), from the narrower panels; viewed in a float_boat render, nothing shows through. big17 review (the skirt as soft cloth, wider bend bands): Body count 25 -> 26 at extreme_pose, the stress stage's raised thigh (one more vertex under the vest's armhole edge, 46.7 mm, inside the limit).
asha._prop_grip: M2-CHR-515/520: Asha sets the staff down on the floor beside her where she kneels, sits or crouches (hero_clips.prop_down), so it no longer crosses her pooled skirt there. Still allowed: pole_in and pole_out, which pole the raft with the staff in both hands (the shaft passes the skirt's front; re-authoring the arms is a follow-up), and attack (one line through her own sleeve at the strike's wind-up).

rhen._allowances: M1-CHR-15 (every-frame worst in brackets). Costume 31.5/6 (31.2): the shirt's side against the forearm and the lowered upper arm (finisher, talk). Body 62/44 (61.1, item@6; count 42 every frame once merged with M2-CHR-12's clips): the toss lifts the right arm 92 degrees forward and its front passes the shirt's armhole edge; with the arms down (idle, talk) the armpit is under 30 since the shoulder correctives. max_exposed 24: the thigh's hidden-face edge opens inside the deep knee fold of the kneel, under the trousers (rhen_clip_kneel).

toma._allowances: M1-CHR-15 (every-frame worst in brackets). Costume 32/6 (31.7, talk): his broad torso takes the lowered upper arm into the tunic's side at mid-arm (linear skinning). Body 75/200 (73.9, run@4, every frame, after merging M2-CHR-12; the CHR-15 clips alone were 53.6, finisher): his toes through the trouser hem where the hem flares over the foot at the run's toe-off, and as the lunge flexes the ankle (follow-up in M2-CHR-513); the armpit is 18.5 in idle (69 in walk before the shoulder correctives). Props: no allowance (16.6 -> 0: the spear sits 3.4 cm out and its foot 1.2 degrees forward, and spear_level and lower_spear swing the arm out while the hand turns it). max_exposed 2: two shoulder-edge vertices, under 5 mm.

sefir._garments: act1_npcs.md §1.10: the long hair is a garment (HairBack), so hair passing through the mantle or the shoulders in a head turn shows up in garment_in_body and is fixed by weights, not hidden

ysolde._allowances: Costume 31/6: the trousers and the back robe panel fold into the calf behind the bent knee in the run (85 degrees; under the robe, unseen), and the sleeve's underarm enters the side of the chest by up to 22 mm as the arm hangs (ysolde_clip_reink_shell, ysolde_clip_cast_glyph: covered by the sleeve itself). Body 45/70: with the arm raised forward (book_fan, cast_glyph) the top of the upper arm passes the dropped shoulder's gusset (the sleeve's top, blended to the torso) by up to 45 mm, and elsewhere the side of the chest passes it by up to 33 mm as the arm comes down or across (vigil_book_shut, stand_apart): linear skinning, covered by the sleeve and the arm (ysolde_clip_cast_glyph); the gusset already blends to the torso's weights, and the sleeve reaches in over the shoulder top and the bodice holds the strap's height over the front and back of the shoulder cap with its own gusset toward the arm (no skin shows between the bodice and the sleeve). max_exposed 4: four upper-arm boundary vertices at the armpit, inside the sleeve's mouth, open by up to 15 mm in talk and cast_glyph. Everything else is at the defaults: no limb, foot or prop penetration (the book, the guards and the pin at 0), welded seams 0.

kell._villager: M3-CHR-03: a villager build (assets/characters/villagers/kell/kell.glb, clips from villager_clips.py). The wick, wick bundle and shears are scene props (assets/characters/props/wick/) on BoneAttachment3Ds, not in the GLB.
kell._allowances: M3-CHR-03 ratchets (garment_fit build; the knees, shins and thighs stay under the calf skirt, keep_above_knee_m 1.0, which took the walk's exposed thigh edge from 110 mm to 0). kerrid._allowances: M3-CHR-505 (cloud probe at the default stride; renders on the PC). Costume 45/6 (44.0, the battle library's idle: kerrid.md §10.3's stance, both hands on the haft, takes the left arm across the chest and its dropped-shoulder sleeve into the torso on the armpit side, out of sight; 39.4 in collar_haul; 32-35 in walk, run, set_bowl_on_post): Ysolde's dropped-shoulder smock sleeve takes the hanging upper arm into its side at mid-arm under linear skinning, and collar_haul lifts the right arm to haul a man up by the collar. Wrap 17/6 (16.8, hold_rib_on_shoulder): the wrap's top turn folds into the upper arm's crease with the left elbow bent past 120 degrees under the beam. Body 39/64 (38.2, collar_haul; 29-34 in finisher, hold_rib_on_shoulder, unsling_cleaver): the raised right arm's front passes the sleeve's mouth (as Rhen's item toss, Toma's run). max_exposed 11: under the dropped sleeve's mouth the cut edge of the upper arm's skin shows as the arm hangs (up to 20 mm from the cloth, seen only from under the armpit); keeping that skin instead made it poke through the sleeve at 80-150 mm in every clip. The back cleaver is hidden in battle (kerrid.md §4.1 #11), so it is not checked there (hidden_props).

moll._allowances: M3-CHR-507 (cloud probe at the default stride). Costume 18/6 (17.9, finisher; 16.6, hit; 16.1 in kneel, ko and yield): the jack's armhole edge, dropped 11.5 cm under the shoulder (M1-CHR-14), takes the lowered left upper arm into it at the side (linear skinning, as Toma's tunic and Liss's top), and the trouser's knee folds into the thigh in the 96-degree kneel (as Liss's kneel). Sleeves 7/6 (6.8, finisher): the sleeves are offset shells of the arm skin, and at the armpit crease they sit inside the torso as the arm comes forward (Liss's work-sleeve, 12). Body 19/48 (18.4, ko and yield; 16.9, kneel): in the yield the right arm comes across the body to the planted iron and the torso's side passes the sleeve's inner face at the armpit; in the kneel the tucked right toes press through the sandal's strap. max_exposed 4: the underarm skin is cut under the hanging arm (it passed through the sleeves), and with the arm raised in the finisher's lift up to four of its edge vertices (under 8 mm) and one at the back of the left shoulder's cap edge (about 2.5 mm, every pose) have no cloth over them. The prop guards (grip, through_garment) and both props' prop_in_body pass with no allowance.

pell._stage_poses: The crest's two keys (crest_raise, crest_flat) are morph targets, which rig_probe does not apply; tools/tests/test_pell.py checks the Crest clear of the head in both keys (its crest_raise stage pose) instead.
pell._allowances: M3-CHR-506 after the look-dev review (cloud probe at the default stride; every-key worst in brackets). The defaults hold in the idle, walk, talk and the story stand clips except where noted. Costume 45/6 (41.8, the ko/revive squat: the mantle's front fall folds into the belly as he sinks onto his heels and bows his neck to the floor; 36-37 in finisher and cast, 25-28 in attack, item, storm_call: the mantle's arm band against the raised right arm). Body 103/113 (102.8, ko/revive: both forearms on the knees take the right upper arm's front up through the mantle's shoulder cap; 77-78 in cast and storm_call, the right palm on the throat, the elbow kept 22 cm under the shoulder, seen in pell_clip_storm_call and pell_storm_ch8 as the cap's underside at the armpit; 42-46 in item and defend). Wraps 19/6 (18.7, ko/revive: the forearm wrap on the knee; 13.3 in storm_call, the wrap's top turn in the full elbow fold). NameShell 45/6 (42.6, ko/revive: the throat cord with the neck bowed 125 degrees; 16-27 in defend, finisher, storm_call, cast as the trapezius and the thick neck rise under it), NameShellBlank/Carved 20/6 (19.6, ko/revive; 18.9 in storm_call: the palm lies over the shell on the throat, as the sheet stages it; 6-8 in defend, run, attack). Crest 5/4 (4.5, ko/revive: the bowed head lays the crest's tips on the left thigh). max_exposed 23 (15 seen; ko/revive up to 44 mm: the cut edge under the mantle's front fall shows at the belly in the deep squat; 12 verts up to 13 mm in run, attack, defend, read, hit at the right breast under the mantle's front edge). Lower them when the mantle gets a squat-aware fold. GPU pass 3 look (muscle 0.6): the crest's count at the ko squat 4 -> 5 (4.3 mm, within the depth limit), the head bowed to the thigh.

stillguard_a._allowances: M3-CHR-508 (probe at the default stride, shield arm SG_SHIELD_ARM). The prop guards (spear grip turn and offset, through_garment) and both props' prop_in_body (Spear, Shield) pass with no allowance; the Helm passes at the default. Costume and Sleeves: Moll's (M3-CHR-507) -- the jack's armhole edge, dropped under the shoulder (M1-CHR-14), takes the lowered upper arm into it at the side, and the sleeve shells sit inside the torso at the armpit crease as the arm comes forward (walk's swing, level_spear's reach). Body (skin_through_garment): at rest (the A pose) the inner face of the upper arm lies against that dropped armhole edge (0.1-0.5 mm on these builds, 6 mm on Moll's broader one, where the sleeve is the nearer cloth), so the probe tracks the jack's edge as the cloth over that skin; as the arm hangs it goes in under the armhole edge, inside the jack, and the depth is how far the arm passes under it, not skin showing through (the sleeve stays over it; the renders show none). max_exposed: in shield_up the raised left arm opens the front of the armpit's underarm cut (one to three edge vertices, behind the raised shield) and in the walk one at the back of the left shoulder's cap edge (under 5 mm), as Moll's finisher. M3-CHR-590 (the dialogue clips): in kneel_palms_flat (Toma's two-knee kneel, as Ivo's) the trouser's knee fold takes the shin into the thigh (Costume, up to 16.7 mm) and the calf presses up into the back of that fold (Body: 36-57 vertices, hidden behind the thigh; the depth stays under the squad's arm-under-armhole limit), and the sleeve shells sit in the armpit crease as both arms come forward to the floor (Sleeves); walk_torch's raised shield arm puts the sleeve into the armpit crease as level_spear's reach does, and on the two broader builds (b, e) opens the front of the underarm cut by up to six edge vertices behind the raised arm, as shield_up does.
